note: Per-town police and fire data for the nine valley towns. Facts trace to the source URL on each item. Several 2025 town reports could not be fully read this session (the PDF reader stops after about the first 100 pages of text or the file would not open), so many 2025 police and fire totals are missing. Incidents are described by type, place and date only; no names of people involved.

programs.name: Outdoor burning permits
programs.detail: Required for any outdoor fire unless the ground is snow-covered.

burnPermits.text: New Hampshire requires a written permit for outdoor burning unless the ground is covered with snow. Get one from the local Forest Fire Warden or fire department, or online at NHFirePermit.com if the town takes part. You must be 18 or older.

recent.title: Floor collapse at a Chocorua event venue
recent.detail: A floor gave way at the start of a wedding ceremony at an event venue in Chocorua; about 70 people fell into the basement and six were taken to the hospital, none with life-threatening injuries, according to the State Fire Marshal's office. The Fire Marshal's office and Tamworth Fire/Rescue opened a joint investigation.
